items.item_text: Licensure as a California Physical Therapist
2 years of licensed acute care experience preferred
Current BLS certification from AHA or ARC
More than 5 years of licensed PT experience qualifies for the PT 2, Per Diem title

At UCLA Health, our comprehensive team of highly skilled and compassionate rehab professionals is giving new life to thousands of people every year. We do it by transforming our passion for life into leading-edge rehab advancements and achievements. Join us and make a vital contribution to others’ lives.

Primary functions are to provide applicable weekend physical therapy care for patients with various diagnoses in the acute care setting. Major duties include: patient evaluation, patient treatment, documentation requirements, maintains expected productivity levels (including special assignments). More than 5 years of licensed PT experience qualifies for PT 2, Per Diem title.
$77.85 - $97.31 per hour. May convert to a career appointment.
Must work 2 weekend days per month

the final candidate who accepts an offer of employment will be required to disclose if they have been subject to any final administrative or judicial decisions within the last seven years determining that they committed any misconduct; or have filed an appeal of a finding of substantiated misconduct with a previous employer.
